The Karenin family Yule Ball was the most talked about on the streets of St. Petersburg. Everyone wanted the honor of being invited, but only the most influential people in Russian society had that privilege.

Alexei Vronsky had always been one of the lucky ones to be invited to this event. And now, more than ever, he felt like the luckiest man in the world to be able to stand beside the woman he was in love with and witness her beauty throughout the night.

His blue eyes roamed the entire elegant hall until he witnessed her, descending the stairs beside her husband, the famous aristocrat Karenin. However, Alexei focused solely on you.

In slow, flirtatious steps, he walked over to you and bowed slightly in front of you, bringing your gloved hand to his lips, kissing it lightly.

 "Allow me to say that your beauty is breathtaking, madam." He said, his voice husky and slightly seductive.
